和设定上作为地方性辅币的铜钱。: plus copper coins, which in the lore are a local fractional currency.

价格会随着时间恢复，但这是一个极慢的过程。: Prices recover over time, but very slowly.
根本没人喜欢这种机制！它已经被删掉了！: Nobody liked this mechanic! It has been removed!

同理，进入【第四幕】后，【第二幕】的商人将不会继续刷新。: Likewise, once you reach 【Act IV】, 【Act II】 merchants stop refreshing.
【第一幕】和【第二幕】的商人每个血洛日会重置物品栏。: 【Act I】 and 【Act II】 merchants reset their stock every Xuelo Day.
【第三幕】的商人2个血洛日重置一次物品栏。: 【Act III】 merchants reset their stock every 2 Xuelo Days.
【第四幕】的商人5个血洛日重置一次物品栏。: 【Act IV】 merchants reset their stock every 5 Xuelo Days.
物品：大部分是无聊的东西，比如消耗品或进一步合成的原料: Items: mostly boring stuff, like consumables or materials for further crafting
部件：可以被进一步组装成装备的物品: Components: items that can be assembled into equipment
它们的质量并不直接转移到装备数据，它们的属性会显示为“预期值”: Their quality does not carry over to the equipment directly; their stats are shown as "expected values",
也就是它们制作的对应质量装备的数值。: i.e. the stats of equipment of that quality made from them.
装备: 你真正可以穿上的东西，大部分由部件组成。: Equipment: things you can actually wear, mostly made from components.
品质会被技能等级与部件等级所影响。: Quality depends on skill level and component tier.
你可以从被动活动与战利品中获取物品，可以被用来合成的物品常常会在介绍中提到它的用: You get items from passive activities and loot; items used in crafting usually say what they are for in their description.
对于被动活动，需要的时间，成功几率，获取物品的数量，都会被技能等级影响。: For passive activities, the time needed, the success chance and the amount gained all depend on skill level.
装备的质量会在一定范围之内，也会被质量上限修正。: Equipment quality falls within a range and is also adjusted by the quality cap.
一般而言，装备质量和部件等级负相关，和工作台等级正相关，和技能等级正相关。: Generally, quality goes down with component tier and up with workbench tier and skill level.
部件质量的详细公式:(80 + 技能等级 * 2 + 工作台等级 * 10 -: Component quality formula: (80 + skill level * 2 + workbench tier * 10 - component tier * 10 ± 15)%
取整到最近的整4%数(出于堆叠方便的考虑): rounded to the nearest multiple of 4% (so they stack better)
装备质量的详细公式:[部件品质对(部件等级+1)的加权平均] ± 15%: Equipment quality formula: [average of component qualities weighted by (component tier + 1)] ± 15%
Note: component tiers and workbench tiers currently both range 0~14.
批量合成和真·批量合成: Bulk crafting and True Bulk crafting
使用【max】按键来进行批量合成。: Use the 【max】 button to craft in bulk.
默认批量合成状态下，每一次合成都将被详细计算。: In normal bulk crafting, every single craft is computed in full.
实际上等同于你点了很多次合成键。: It is the same as clicking the craft button many times.
物品的真·批量合成在合成成功率为100%时激活。: True Bulk crafting for items kicks in when the success rate is 100%.
它将会计算目前可合成数量，而后一次性给予经验值和物品。: It computes how many you can craft, then grants the XP and items all at once.
未激活真·批量合成时，为性能考虑，单次点击max只能合成1001次。: Without True Bulk crafting, one click on max crafts at most 1001 times, for performance.
部件的真·批量合成在可以合成1000份以上部件时激活。: True Bulk crafting for components kicks in when you can craft 1000+ components.
原理是把单次合成分为100轮（小数部分经过特殊处理，确保总合成数不变）: It splits the batch into 100 rounds (fractions are handled so the total count stays the same)
而每一轮的品质平均分配，单轮结束时统一加经验。: and spreads quality evenly within each round, granting XP at the end of each round.
在1000+的规模上，这种近似不至于产生大影响。: At 1000+ this approximation makes little difference.
而且，这样就算9e15个材料也不怕了！: And this way even 9e15 materials are no problem!
装备的真·批量合成在选择的部件数量均超过100时激活。: True Bulk crafting for equipment kicks in when every selected component has more than 100.
品质会统统平分。我实在懒得加和√N成正比的标准差了。: Quality is simply averaged. I really couldn't be bothered to add a standard deviation proportional to √N.
同样的，这样可以彻底抹去这一块的性能问题！: Again, this wipes out the performance problem here entirely!
一切影响 命中/闪避 的 技能/环境 的总和。: The sum of all skills/environment effects on hit/dodge.
直接转换为角色/怪物的攻击速度。2 * SPD = 同样的时间进行两次攻击。: Converts directly into character/monster attack speed. 2 × SPD = two attacks in the same time.
为了避免精神错乱/潜在的问题，在战斗开始时，攻击速度会被折算以确保没有什么的攻击: To avoid madness/potential problems, attack speed is scaled at the start of combat so that nothing attacks faster than 1/s.
喂喂！攻速软上限是要急死我吗！: Hey! Is the attack speed soft cap trying to drive me crazy?!
The attack speed soft cap has been raised to 10/s.
当体力降到0，角色的攻击速度和攻击伤害会下降一半。: When stamina drops to 0, the character's attack speed and damage are halved.
惩罚会被“忍饥挨饿”技能削弱，该技能在0体力战斗时获得经验。: The penalty is reduced by the "Starving" skill, which gains XP while fighting at 0 stamina.
它也会被提升体力上限/体力恢复削弱，例如使用食物恢复体力。: It is also reduced by higher max stamina/stamina regen, e.g. eating food.
体力系统？谁会喜欢时不时来重新挂一下角色！: A stamina system? Who likes having to come back and restart their character every so often!
在合理的范围内，会对猫可露露进行复刻。: Within reason, these recreate Maoke Lulu.
对地图伤害/结算伤害等属性，: For stats like map damage/settlement damage,
优先做到“等效”，如果做不到则增添新效果。: equivalence comes first; where that is impossible, new effects are added.
目标是更切实的体会到【特殊属性】的作用！: The goal is to make 【Special Stats】 feel meaningful!
For example, after a round of balancing, 【Time Seal】's expected damage relative to the original is about the same as other monsters'.

微尘级，最弱势的群体，体质虚弱。: Dust Rank: the weakest group, frail in body.

不同境界突破会增加不同的属性。: Different realm breakthroughs raise different stats.
万物级初等，潮汐级初等会分别提供0.1,0.15的攻速。: Myriad Rank Novice and Tidal Rank Novice give 0.1 and 0.15 attack speed respectively.
{{}}每阶提供0.1普攻倍率(一阶*2，破限没有): {{}} gives 0.1 Normal Attack Multiplier per stage (×2 at Stage 1, none at Limit Break)

我似乎需要解说一下非常规战斗属性。: I should probably explain the unusual combat stats.
普攻倍率，就是每次攻击的伤害加成，在扣除防御之后最后计算。: Normal Attack Multiplier is a damage bonus on every attack, applied last, after defense.
幸运，影响杀怪的经验获取和掉落物。基本上如果基础掉落0.5%，幸运500%，那最: Luck affects XP and drops from kills. Basically, a 0.5% base drop with 500% Luck ends up at 2.5%.
一些特殊的BOSS级掉落可能会被[Fixed]，这代表它们不被幸运影响。。: Some special boss drops may be marked [Fixed], meaning Luck does not affect them.
SCGV，影响宝石软上限。宝石被软上限削弱的比例是(它们提供的总属性/单颗属性/: SCGV affects the gem soft cap. How much gems are reduced by the soft cap is a function of (total stats they give / stats per gem / SCGV).
如果感兴趣的话，SCGV的全称是 SoftcappedGemValue。: In case you wondered, SCGV stands for SoftcappedGemValue.
提供不同的奖励与削弱，在不同情况下有不同的用处。: They give different bonuses and penalties, each useful in different situations.
在战斗中修改秘法会重置攻击条。（不许作弊！）: Switching Arcane Arts mid-combat resets the attack bar. (No cheating!)
同一类的【念力兵器】之间的用法是共通的。: 【Psychokinetic Weapons】 of the same type share their mastery.
人话就是：用了低级材料做的【念力兵器】练级获取了普攻倍率之后，高级材料的也有倍率: In plain words: once you level up a low-material 【Psychokinetic Weapon】 and gain its attack multiplier, the high-material one has that multiplier too.
别看它的基础属性不咋地...可是有高贵的独立乘区！！: Its base stats may look meh... but it has its own noble multiplier bracket!!
根据原作血洛大陆的描述，建立了血洛计时系统。: Based on the original work's Xuelo Continent, a Xuelo calendar was built.
血洛大陆的计时系统分为纪元-年-日-小时-分。: The Xuelo calendar goes era - year - day - hour - minute.
1小时=60分钟，1日=180小时，50日=1年，10081年=1纪元。: 1 hour = 60 minutes, 1 day = 180 hours, 50 days = 1 year, 10081 years = 1 era.
如此，血洛1分钟大约等于地球58.9秒。: That makes one Xuelo minute about 58.9 Earth seconds.
在普通区域的夜晚 (150~30时), 以及黑暗区域的全天 , Neko 会得到: At night in normal areas (hours 150~30), and all day in dark areas, Neko gets an extra Agility penalty.
该惩罚会被“夜视”削弱——仅仅是呆在这样的区域就会被动获得“夜视”经验。: The penalty is reduced by "Night vision" — just being in such an area passively gives "Night vision" XP.
一些战斗区域存在特殊的性质，带来了特定属性上的惩罚。: Some combat areas have special properties that penalize certain stats.
例子：一些区域或许没有充足的移动区域，导致躲避变得困难。: Example: some areas may lack room to move, making dodging harder.
它们一般拥有一个配套技能来削弱惩罚，同样在这样的区域中就能被动获取经验。: They usually come with a matching skill that reduces the penalty, which also gains XP passively in those areas.
更强的怪物提供更多的经验。它不会被区域属性影响，但是会被怪物数量^0.334影响: Stronger monsters give more XP. It is not affected by zone properties, but it is affected by monster count^0.334 (fighting 8 monsters at once gives 2x XP).
这里也有很多来源丰富的加成(主要是技能里程碑),境界提升也能给技能经验值带来增强: There are also plenty of bonuses from various sources (mainly skill milestones), and raising your realm also boosts skill XP.
{新地点,新行动}，会因为{和某人说话，通过某个区域(可能需要不止一次),行动的: {New locations, new actions} unlock by {talking to someone, clearing a zone (possibly more than once), completing an action [Worked!]}
所有可装备物品都有“质量”乘数，它直接影响装备的基础属性（武器的攻击，护甲的防御: Every equippable item has a "quality" multiplier that directly affects its base stats (weapon attack, armor defense) and price.
除此以外，更高的稀有度等级会提供另一个乘数(只与等级相关)，影响装备的[全部]属: On top of that, higher rarity tiers give another multiplier (depending only on the tier) that affects [all] the item's stats.
在版本 V3.0X , 商人提供物品的最高质量为 273%.[需要9999个冰宫: In version V3.0X, the highest quality sold by merchants is 273%. [Requires 9999 Ice Palace Merchants]
如果使用大量材料练习技能，理论上可能制造出质量300%+(超越)的防具和武器。: If you train your skills with lots of materials, you can in theory craft 300%+ (Transcendent) armor and weapons.
宝石颜色不再指示宝石的属性，而是指示等级: Gem color no longer shows the gem's stat; it shows the tier

如果使用的宝石获取的属性太多，获取的属性将会被软上限限制！: If the gems you use give too many stats, the gain is soft-capped!

在结界湖区域加入的全新机制。: A new mechanic added with the Barrier Lake area.
读条过程和砍伐，采矿等一致，但读条结束后会进入拉扯界面。: The progress bar works like woodcutting, mining, etc., but when it finishes you enter a tug-of-war screen.
按住屏幕提升“钓鱼条”，松手使它自然下落。: Hold on the screen to raise the "fishing bar"; let go and it falls.

起初【控制力】是1.00，当钓鱼等级超过20级时每级增长0.05！: 【Control】 starts at 1.00 and grows 0.05 per level once Fishing is above level 20!
此外，浮漂外围有一圈22.5%的【霜天】区域——区域内鱼不咬钩，但也不会脱钩。: There is also a 22.5% 【Frost Sky】 ring around the float — inside it the fish won't bite, but won't escape either.

【核心反应堆】是纳可在天外飞船中发现的【科技造物】。: The 【Core Reactor】 is a 【Technological Creation】 Neko found in the Outer-Space Spaceship.
它拥有良好的原能反射能力，可以诱导出【A7·能量核心】与【B1·能量核心】的原能: It reflects primal energy well and can draw out the primal energy of 【A7 Energy Cores】 and 【B1 Energy Cores】.
这些原能可以被用于制作超高强度的【凝胶剑柄】，或是凝聚成【初级进化结晶】。: That primal energy can make extremely strong 【Gel Sword Hilts】, or be condensed into 【Basic Evolution Crystals】.
不过务必往里面添加一些【高能凝胶】作为冷却剂。否则，反应堆温度过高会导致熔毁。: But be sure to add some 【High-Energy Gel】 as coolant. Otherwise the reactor overheats and melts down.
灵感来源: HBM的核科技 - RBMK反应堆。: Inspiration: HBM's Nuclear Tech - the RBMK reactor.
根据公式0.4lg(n+1)x增殖反应堆内的【原能辐射】。: Multiplies the reactor's 【Primal-Energy Radiation】 by the formula 0.4·lg(n+1)·x.
在【317】颗会进入【超临界】状态，导致【原能辐射】持续指数增长。: At 【317】 cores it goes 【Supercritical】, and 【Primal-Energy Radiation】 grows exponentially.
热值为【8000】。代表1颗B1·能量核心完全燃烧可以释放8000【原能】。: Heat value 【8000】: one B1 Energy Core burned completely releases 8000 【Primal Energy】.
根据公式0.4sqrt(nx)增殖反应堆内的【原能辐射】。: Multiplies the reactor's 【Primal-Energy Radiation】 by the formula 0.4·sqrt(n·x).
Never goes 【Supercritical】. Ignoring other 【Primal-Energy Radiation】 sources, 2% is consumed per second.
热值为【20】。代表1颗A7·能量核心完全燃烧可以释放20【原能】。: Heat value 【20】: one A7 Energy Core burned completely releases 20 【Primal Energy】.
和前两种燃料相比，最大的好处是不需要任何原能辐射即可启动。: Its big advantage over the other two fuels is that it starts without any primal-energy radiation.
热值为【1】。代表1颗雷电加护完全燃烧仅仅释放1【原能】。: Heat value 【1】: one Thunder Ward burned completely releases just 1 【Primal Energy】.
可以用它来【完全焚烧】前两种燃料。但它本身永远无法被【完全焚烧】。: You can use it to 【Completely Incinerate】 the other two fuels, but it can never be 【Completely Incinerated】 itself.
根据公式0.01n加强反应堆的热容(【原能辐射】与【温度变化】的比值): Increases the reactor's heat capacity (the ratio of 【Primal-Energy Radiation】 to 【Temperature Change】) by the formula 0.01·n
在反应时加入也可以为反应堆降温。: Adding it during a reaction also cools the reactor.

热容的提升也有少许代价。根据平方立方定律，自然冷却的速度随凝胶量增加以n^-1/: More heat capacity has a small cost: by the square-cube law, natural cooling slows as n^-1/3 as gel increases.
这代表着，在10个【高能凝胶】时反应堆的冷却速度是-10%/s,到了10000个: So with 10 【High-Energy Gel】 the reactor cools at -10%/s, and at 10000 only at -1%/s.
每次提取消耗反应堆中20%的【高能凝胶】与全部的【吸收原能】。: Each extraction uses 20% of the reactor's 【High-Energy Gel】 and all of its 【Absorbed Primal Energy】.
因此，够用即可，多加也是浪费。: So add just enough; more is a waste.
为了获取史诗，传说，神话，超凡【凝胶剑柄】: To get Epic, Legendary, Mythic and Transcendent 【Gel Sword Hilts】

击败【飞船核心-下方房间】中的【银色血眼B1[BOSS]】可以获取大量反应堆材料: Beating 【Silver Blood-Eye B1 [BOSS]】 in the 【Spaceship Core – Lower Room】 yields lots of reactor materials.
同时，还能获取【进化结晶炼制-一学就会】。由此，有了凝聚【初等进化结晶】的能力。: You also get 【Evolution Crystal Refinement – Instant Mastery】, which lets you condense 【Basic Evolution Crystals】.
凝聚【初等进化结晶】需要消耗1,000,000【原能辐射】。: Condensing a 【Basic Evolution Crystal】 costs 1,000,000 【Primal-Energy Radiation】.
同时，这会消耗反应堆中{{}}的高能凝胶。: It also consumes {{}} of the reactor's High-Energy Gel.

当温度超过9999°C,温度条冒蓝光，: When the temperature passes 9999°C, the temperature bar glows blue,
虽然它不会因为爆炸再也不能用，: It won't be unusable forever after the blast,

虽然听着很奇怪，但全称应该是【赫尔沼泽原能辐射扩散程度】。: It sounds odd, but the full name is 【Hel Swamp Primal-Energy Radiation Spread】.
设定上，3-1区域【赫尔沼泽】的兽潮便是原能辐射引发。: In the lore, the beast tide in Zone 3-1 【Hel Swamp】 is caused by primal-energy radiation.
因此，过量的外溢原能辐射会导致兽潮更加狂暴。: So excess leaked primal-energy radiation makes the beast tide more ferocious.
Concretely, it's an aura effect like the one in 【Na Family Secret Realm – ∞】.....
使用【初等进化结晶】时，【压级损耗的经验】会以100亿:1%的比例增加【沼泽辐射: When you use a 【Basic Evolution Crystal】, the 【XP Lost to Level Suppression】 adds 【Swamp Radiation Spread】 at 10 billion : 1%.
换言之，天空级一阶~0/结晶，天空级二阶~8%/结晶，天空级三阶~9.6%/结晶: In other words: Sky Rank Stage 1 ~0 per crystal, Stage 2 ~8% per crystal, Stage 3 ~9.6% per crystal.
击杀【一只荒兽】，它的能力回归天地会带来【0.004%】的【沼泽辐射扩散】。: Killing 【A Wild Beast】 returns its power to the world and adds 【0.004%】 【Swamp Radiation Spread】.
虽然不多，但如果以2.0的攻速/每次攻击3个对象/一刀杀，每个血洛日会增加多达1: Not much, but at 2.0 attack speed / 3 targets per attack / one-hit kills, that is up to 10.8% 【Swamp Radiation Spread】 per Xuelo Day.
辐射越多，荒兽越强。荒兽越强，打的越慢。打的越慢，辐射越少。: More radiation, stronger beasts. Stronger beasts, slower kills. Slower kills, less radiation.
所以，辐射越多，辐射越少。: So: more radiation means less radiation.
不要觉得好笑！这可是完☆美的负反馈设计！: Don't laugh! That is a per☆fect negative feedback design!
唯一的减少方式为时光的流逝。: The only way down is the passage of time.
每个【血洛日】，会自然减少【1%+1%比例】的【沼泽辐射扩散】。: Every 【Xuelo Day】, 【Swamp Radiation Spread】 naturally drops by 【1% + 1% ratio】.
为了避免它出现在非3-1的区域，【沼泽辐射扩散】不足1%时不会有减少提示。: So that it doesn't show up outside 3-1, there is no decrease message while 【Swamp Radiation Spread】 is below 1%.
如果不小心吃多了结晶...可以睡一觉解决。: If you accidentally ate too many crystals... sleeping it off works.
不睡觉情况下半衰期约为2.8小时，睡觉则为28分钟。(均忽略1%的被动扩散，实际: Without sleep the half-life is about 2.8 hours; with sleep, 28 minutes. (Both ignore the 1% passive term, which you really can't, but then the differential equation gets nasty.)
【极寒相变引擎】是纳可在纯白冰原中自己制造的【器械】。: The 【Extreme-Cold Phase-Change Engine】 is an 【Apparatus】 Neko built herself in the Pure White Arctic Tundra.
它的全名应为【极寒气冷二级相变引擎 / Freezing Air Cooled: Its full name is the 【Freezing Air Cooled Second Order Phase Transformation Engine】
它的原理相当简单粗暴……压缩气体会释放热量，而让气体膨胀会吸收热量。: The principle is crude and simple... compressing gas releases heat, and letting it expand absorbs heat.
因此，只要在外面压缩气体，在一个隔热袋里让气体膨胀，就可以制冷了！: So compress gas outside, let it expand inside an insulated bag, and you have refrigeration!
将冰原超流体冷却到极低温度之后，它吸收冰元素的速度会呈超指数增长。: Once Arctic Superfluid is cooled to extremely low temperatures, it absorbs ice elements super-exponentially faster.
届时，本应消耗万年的【万载冰髓】产生过程可以被压缩到分钟乃至秒。: Then forming 【Ten-Thousand-Year Ice Marrow】, which should take ten thousand years, can be squeezed into minutes or even seconds.
灵感来源: 逆·阿伦尼乌斯方程&物理化学第一章。: Inspiration: the inverse Arrhenius equation & chapter 1 of physical chemistry.
显然，任何种类的【能量核心】都不可能吸收热量……: Obviously, no kind of 【Energy Core】 can absorb heat...
而简易工质轮机的效率极低，可以同时耐数万度高温和数千TPa压强的金属即使在天空级: Simple working-fluid turbines are terribly inefficient, and metal that withstands tens of thousands of degrees and thousands of TPa at once is rare even at Sky Rank.
所以！喵可只能亲自推活塞了！: So! Neko has to push the piston herself!
为避免出现精度问题，每秒气体的量/活塞内部体积最多变为e倍或1/e倍。: To avoid precision issues, the gas amount / piston volume can change by at most a factor of e or 1/e per second.
如果上一条上限跑不满，则【压缩】和【打气】行动的速度将完全取决于喵可的能力。: If that cap isn't reached, the speed of 【Compress】 and 【Pump】 depends entirely on Neko's power.
功率 = ATK ^ 1.5。单位是W，而显示的是GW。: Power = ATK ^ 1.5. The unit is W; the display shows GW.
对了，记得切成单体攻击秘法。这里可没有几个活塞给你群攻。: Oh, and switch to a single-target Arcane Art. There aren't several pistons here for your AoE.
[冰原空气] 是一种单原子，且极其接近理想气体的气体。: [Tundra Air] is monatomic and extremely close to an ideal gas.
因此，它的绝热系数约为5/3，意即绝热操作时压强的比例变化率是体积的比例变化率的: So its adiabatic index is about 5/3: in adiabatic operation, the relative change in pressure is 5/3 of the relative change in volume.
选修过化学的应该都知道，这代表剩下的2/3变为了热能！: Anyone who took chemistry knows that means the other 2/3 turns into heat!
活塞在环境中时，温度会以0.1(T2-T1)的速度向环境温度靠拢。: While the piston is in the environment, its temperature approaches ambient at a rate of 0.1·(T2-T1).
极寒冰原的默认环境温度是240K。: The Frigid Tundra's default ambient temperature is 240K.
后者则代表热辐射。在1200K以上时后者将占主导地位。: The latter is thermal radiation. Above 1200K the latter dominates.
基本将多余的热量散掉之后，就可以松开手，让气体【膨胀】。: Once most of the excess heat is gone, let go and let the gas 【Expand】.
此时，它的温度会下降，可以为隔热袋制冷。: Its temperature then drops, cooling the insulated bag.
此外，膨胀的上限是30m³，而压缩的上限是0.3m³。: The expansion limit is 30m³, and the compression limit is 0.3m³.
喵可学艺不精，活塞的底部凹凸不平，压不进去了……: Neko's craftsmanship isn't great; the piston bottom is uneven and won't go any further...
原本这里是有热辐射设定的。但是悲哀的是，它在12000K以上极端不稳定，会导致模: There used to be thermal radiation here. Sadly, it was extremely unstable above 12000K and broke the simulation, spewing NaN everywhere.
具体来说，在1帧之内它就把自己的温度辐射到一个很大的负数……: Specifically, within 1 frame it would radiate its own temperature down to a huge negative number...
虽然可以用微分方程来确认温度的真实变化率，但这实在太累了。: You could get the true rate of change with a differential equation, but that's way too much work.
因此，在纱雪想出更好的办法之前……不需要它也无所谓了啦。: So until Shaxue thinks of something better... we can do without it.
想要扩大生产？没问题！: Want to scale up? No problem!
初始时刻活塞中有1亿mol的冰原空气，但是显然可以塞进去更多。: The piston starts with 100 million mol of Tundra Air, but you can clearly cram in more.
更多的空气代表着压缩更为困难，但气体的热容也会提升。: More air makes compression harder, but also raises the gas's heat capacity.
如果你的隔热袋里装了好多冰原超流体，那加入更多冰原空气这几乎是必经之路！: If your insulated bag holds a lot of Arctic Superfluid, adding more Tundra Air is practically a must!
过程中还会放一点热，不过鉴于冷空气会进入调和，并不会升温多少。: Pumping releases a little heat, but since cold air mixes in, it doesn't warm up much.
对了，如果有人感兴趣的话，打气计算中做的近似是：: Oh, and if anyone's curious, the approximation used for pumping is:
待打气的冰原空气绝热压缩到内部压力，然后再进行一次整体绝热压缩，最后等待热平衡。: the incoming Tundra Air is compressed adiabatically to the inside pressure, then the whole is compressed adiabatically once more, then it settles to thermal equilibrium.
dN/dt是空气积累速度(mol/s),N是气体总量(mol),P是功率,R是理: dN/dt is the air accumulation rate (mol/s), N the total gas (mol), P the power, R the ideal gas constant, T2 the inside temperature, p2 the inside pressure, T1 the outside temperature, p1 the outside pressure, and dT the temperature change.
切记：贪多嚼不烂……: Remember: don't bite off more than you can chew...
如果打了实在太多的气，压缩会变得极为困难，消耗大量时间。: If you pump in far too much, compressing becomes extremely hard and takes ages.
所幸，有【放气】按钮：每秒将活塞内气体变为原来的1/e倍。小心别放多了！: Luckily there's a 【Deflate】 button: every second it cuts the piston's gas to 1/e. Careful not to let out too much!
如果您需要这么做的话，显然您是贪多嚼不烂了。: If you need it, you clearly bit off more than you could chew.
是一种导热性极强的材料。弛豫时间不足1帧[40ms]: An extremely conductive material. Its relaxation time is under 1 frame [40ms]
为尽可能减少从外界吸收的热量，它总是被堆成球形。: To absorb as little outside heat as possible, it is always piled into a sphere.
当活塞在隔热袋中时，它会和冰原超流体进行热交换。: While the piston is in the insulated bag, it exchanges heat with the Arctic Superfluid.
1m³冰原超流体的热容等于10'000'000 mol 冰原空气。: 1m³ of Arctic Superfluid has the heat capacity of 10'000'000 mol of Tundra Air.
交换的热量与折合热容:Q1Q2/(Q1+Q2)和温差成正比。: Heat exchanged is proportional to the reduced heat capacity Q1Q2/(Q1+Q2) and to the temperature difference.
简单来说，如果一侧热容极小，折合热容会趋向它本身。: Simply put, if one side's heat capacity is tiny, the reduced heat capacity tends toward it.
所以尽可能地让你的冰原超流体和冰原空气热容保持一致吧！: So try to keep the heat capacities of your Arctic Superfluid and Tundra Air equal!
此外，新加入的冰原超流体温度和外界保持一致。: Newly added Arctic Superfluid is at the outside temperature.
这意味着向深度冷却的超流体中添加更多会大幅稀释温度差。: That means adding more to deeply cooled superfluid dilutes the temperature difference a lot.
考虑到热导率反比于厚度，将柯西不等式推广到无限个面积微元，可以发现：: Since heat conduction is inversely proportional to thickness, extending the Cauchy inequality to infinitely many area elements shows that
将隔热层平均分布在冰原超流体表面会是最佳的隔热选择。: spreading the insulation evenly over the Arctic Superfluid surface is the best choice.
隔热层厚度使用的是两个球体半径的差值，1pts多孔冰晶等于0.1m³。: Insulation thickness is the difference between the two sphere radii; 1pt of Porous Ice Crystal is 0.1m³.
因此，增加冰原超流体的量不仅会增大表面积，还会减少隔热层厚度。: So adding Arctic Superfluid not only increases the surface area but also thins the insulation.
瞬时的温度变化率等于0.001*面积*隔热袋与环境温度之差/体积/隔热层厚度。: The instantaneous rate of temperature change is 0.001 × area × (bag temperature - ambient) / volume / insulation thickness.
在初始条件下，这代表着4.6% / s,或制出的热量缺口的半衰期为14.9s。: Under starting conditions that is 4.6%/s, i.e. the cooling you produced has a half-life of 14.9s.
多堆一点隔热总没有坏处！除非你在隔热袋里面压缩气体……: More insulation never hurts! Unless you're compressing gas inside the bag...
冰原超流体在积累超过1000pts/m³的【冰元素】之后会变为【万载冰髓】。: Arctic Superfluid turns into 【Ten-Thousand-Year Ice Marrow】 after accumulating more than 1000pts/m³ of 【Ice Elements】.
【冰元素】是亚原子尺度的小只妖精。它们会在分子动的时候让它别动了。: 【Ice Elements】 are tiny subatomic fairies. When a molecule moves, they tell it to stop.
我也不知道什么原因，但【冰元素】积累速度和常规的化学反应速度恰好相反。: I don't know why either, but 【Ice Elements】 accumulate exactly opposite to normal chemical reaction rates.
比起常规的v=Ae^(-Ep/RT),【冰元素】的单位面积积累速度是σ=a*e^: Instead of the usual v = A·e^(-Ep/RT), 【Ice Elements】 accumulate per unit area at σ = a·e^(b/T).
使用80K下100s内完成转化与240K下万年完成转化拟合，: Fitting full conversion in 100s at 80K and in ten thousand years at 240K
我的意思是，降低一点温度就能让冰元素积累速度大幅提升！: What I mean is: lowering the temperature a little speeds up ice element accumulation a lot!
因此，设法降低隔热袋中的温度吧！减少一些冰原超流体也是值得的！: So find ways to lower the bag's temperature! Even using less Arctic Superfluid can be worth it!

理论上，突破/死亡人数应该服从B(n,p)的二项分布。: In theory, the number of breakthroughs/deaths follows a binomial distribution B(n,p).
然而，n较大时直接模拟会消耗极大的算力，造成严重卡顿。: But for large n, simulating it directly costs a lot of compute and causes serious lag.
因此，采用了【正态分布近似】和【泊松近似】两种算法。: So the 【normal approximation】 and the 【Poisson approximation】 are used instead.
